data.displayName: Nectr Business GreenPower + CL - United Energy - August 2026

fees.description: This fee may be charged when the network disconnect the power to your property remotely.
This fee may be charged when the network reconnect the power to your property remotely.

This fee may apply when the network is requested to visit site and undertake a special meter read. This is a network charge, which Nectr passes through. Actual fee may vary.
Additional fees and charges may apply. Please see the Nectr fee schedules at nectr.com.au/plans-and-fees/united-energy/.

electricityContract.terms: Billing will be monthly with a payment term of 10 business days. For more details on the terms and conditions, visit nectr.com.au/terms-and-conditions/#contracts, contact Nectr on hello@nectr.com.au or call 1300 111 211.
electricityContract.variation: We may vary your rates and charges once every 12 months by providing you with notice of any changes as soon as practicable, and no later than your next bill.

incentives.eligibility: 100% GreenPower is included as part of your plan.

$150 credit added on your electricity account when you sign up using a Refer a Friend link from an existing Nectr customer. Available to new customers only. T&Cs apply. Please refer to nectr.com.au/terms-and-conditions/nectr-refer-a-friend-program/

eligibility.information: This offer is available to customers with an applicable network tariff. If you are not sure which network tariff you have, please contact us to check this offer is available to you.

singleRate.description: Hours of application are determined by your distributor, United Energy.
